newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN RUPIAH SOFTER ON WEEKEND DLR COVERING.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN RUPIAH SOFTER ON WEEKEND DLR COVERING.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was softer against the dollar in early trading on Friday, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said dollar covering ahead of the weekend pulled down the rupiah in dull trading.
"I think it's mainly short-covering ahead of the weekend. But volume is pretty thin," the dealer said.
Spot rupiah was at 2,593.0/95.0 at 0215 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,585.0/93.0. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,592.5/94.5 and 2,591.0/93.0, respectively.
However, one Japanese bank dealer said an easing of money market liquidity aided domestic dollar purchases.
"We see some dollar purchases from local operators. I don't know whether it's because of the improved liquidity or to covering ahead of the weekend," the dealer said.
Overnight rupiah was at around 15.0 percent.
Overnight swap was at 1.35/1.50 and tom/next at 0.40/0.43.
The U.S. bank dealer said swaps were slightly biddish although liquidity was improving. He said it could be due to swap rises in the Thai baht.
One-month swap was at 18.0/20.0, two at 37.0/43.0, three at 58.0/63.0 and six at 118.0/125.0 points.
The rupiah fell on Thursday following a sharp plunge of the stock market index due to new margin rules, rights issue calls and poor corporate earnings prospects.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,378/2,682 but lowered the conversion band to 2,567/2,615 on Thursday from 2,572/2,620 on Wednesday.
